Good rate — that's the cheap end, so the sats you stack cost you very little to make. At $799 the 40T is our best value per TH, and it draws for a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, year after year.

First miner, or adding to a setup?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Magic Miner 40T numbers for where you live.
